_help: Boosters and other consumables worth USING before the step they help instead of selling them. helps: 'fly' = travel/haul steps (FLY to ...), 'mine' = mining steps, 'always' = use at once (it helps whatever you do, e.g. skill training). minutes_saved_per_hour = how much faster the helped step gets while it runs (a guess until timed). min_jumps = only worth it on a trip of at least this many jumps. Add a line when you get a new booster.

boosters.name: AIR Agility Booster II
boosters.effect: -10% inertia (the ship aligns and warps off faster) for 1 hour
boosters.how: cargo or hangar > right-click AIR Agility Booster II > Consume

boosters.name: AIR Agility Booster I
boosters.how: cargo or hangar > right-click AIR Agility Booster I > Consume

boosters.name: Standard Cerebral Accelerator
boosters.effect: +training speed for its duration (skill points come faster while you play)
boosters.how: hangar > right-click > Consume (it starts at once and runs out on its own: never leave it in the hangar)
